```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(backgammonr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

This notebook stays on one problem: the opening board with roll `1-6`.

The main functions are:

- `bg_problem()` to define the decision problem.
- `bg_truth_load()` to load the saved proxy truth from the first notebook.
- `bg_ts_run()` to run canonical Thompson sampling over a budget path.
- `bg_eval_reference_aware()` to score the run against the saved proxy truth.

```{r settings}
truth_budget <- 100000L
roll_1_6_truth_path <- file.path(
  "artifacts",
  "opening_truths",
  paste0("opening_1-6_truth_budget_", truth_budget, ".rds")
)

if (!file.exists(roll_1_6_truth_path)) {
  stop("Run 01_save_all_21_opening_truths.Rmd first so the 1-6 truth file exists.")
}

thompson_budgets <- c(8L, 16L, 32L, 64L, 128L, 256L, 512L, 1024L)
thompson_seed <- 1L

truth_1_6 <- bg_truth_load(roll_1_6_truth_path)

problem_1_6 <- bg_problem(
  state = bg_initial_board(),
  roll = bg_roll(1L, 6L),
  simulation_policy = "random",
  reward_model = "scalar_payoff",
  posterior_model = "beta_pseudo",
  problem_id = "opening_1-6"
)
```

```{r board}
bg_print_board(problem_1_6$board)
```

```{r candidate-table}
knitr::kable(
  problem_1_6$candidate_table[, c(
    "candidate_index",
    "move_label",
    "n_steps",
    "n_hits",
    "n_bar_entries",
    "n_bear_off",
    "n_equivalent_sequences"
  )],
  caption = "Candidate root moves for the 1-6 opening problem."
)
```

```{r truth-summary}
knitr::kable(
  truth_1_6$summary[, c(
    "problem_id",
    "reference_budget",
    "proxy_reference_best_move_label",
    "top_two_gap_estimate",
    "top_two_gap_mc_lower_95",
    "mc_gap_excludes_zero",
    "difficulty_label"
  )],
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Saved proxy truth for opening roll 1-6."
)
```

```{r truth-table}
truth_1_6_table <- truth_1_6$reference$action_table[
  order(truth_1_6$reference$action_table$rank),
  c(
    "rank",
    "candidate_index",
    "move_label",
    "reference_mean",
    "reference_mc_lower_95",
    "reference_mc_upper_95",
    "allocation_count"
  )
]

knitr::kable(
  truth_1_6_table,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Proxy-truth move table for opening roll 1-6."
)
```

```{r thompson-run}
thompson_1_6 <- bg_ts_run(
  problem = problem_1_6,
  budget = max(thompson_budgets),
  checkpoints = thompson_budgets,
  proxy_reference = truth_1_6$reference,
  seed = thompson_seed
)
```

```{r checkpoint-table}
knitr::kable(
  thompson_1_6$checkpoint_table[, c(
    "checkpoint",
    "recommended_move_label",
    "recommended_estimate",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "runtime_seconds",
    "rollout_throughput"
  )],
  digits = 4,
  caption = "How Thompson changes its answer over budget checkpoints."
)
```

```{r final-action-table}
final_thompson_table <- thompson_1_6$action_table[
  order(-thompson_1_6$action_table$recommended, thompson_1_6$action_table$rank),
  c(
    "recommended",
    "rank",
    "candidate_index",
    "move_label",
    "allocation_count",
    "estimate",
    "lower_95",
    "upper_95",
    "model_relative_prob_best",
    "proxy_reference_mean",
    "proxy_reference_rank",
    "simple_regret"
  )
]

knitr::kable(
  final_thompson_table,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Final Thompson action table at the largest budget."
)
```

```{r eval-panel}
thompson_eval <- bg_eval_reference_aware(
  thompson_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  top_k = 3L
)

knitr::kable(
  thompson_eval[, c(
    "checkpoint",
    "recommended_move_label",
    "truth_best_move_label",
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "spearman",
    "top_k_overlap",
    "share_best_truth",
    "allocation_entropy"
  )],
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Reference-aware Thompson metrics over budget."
)
```

```{r truth-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_truth(truth_1_6)
```

```{r allocation-trace, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_ts_trace(thompson_1_6, metric = "allocation", top_n = 10L)
```

```{r prob-best-trace, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_ts_trace(thompson_1_6, metric = "prob_best", top_n = 10L)
```

```{r estimate-trace, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_ts_trace(thompson_1_6, metric = "estimate", top_n = 10L)
```

```{r rank-compare, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_rank_compare(
  thompson_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  checkpoint = max(thompson_budgets),
  top_n = 10L
)
```

```{r allocation-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_allocation(
  thompson_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  checkpoint = max(thompson_budgets),
  top_n = 10L
)
```

```{r simple-regret-line, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
ggplot(thompson_eval, aes(x = checkpoint, y = simple_regret)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0b4f6c", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#c9643b", size = 2.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Simple regret over budget",
    x = "Budget checkpoint",
    y = "Simple regret"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r rank-line, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
ggplot(thompson_eval, aes(x = checkpoint, y = selected_reference_rank)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0b4f6c", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#c9643b", size = 2.2) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = sort(unique(thompson_eval$selected_reference_rank))) +
  labs(
    title = "Selected truth rank over budget",
    x = "Budget checkpoint",
    y = "Selected reference rank"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
